title: Welcome to Poketod SMP: The Ultimate Adventure
excerpt: Discover what awaits you in the new season of Poketod SMP, featuring the ultimate **Cobblemon** experience.
content:
Welcome to Poketod SMP! We are thrilled to announce the launch of our new season.

### What's New?
We have overhauled our modpack to bring you the best **Cobblemon** experience ever! You can now participate in the Player Gym League, discover Mega Evolutions in battles, complete Research Tasks, and trade using the Global Trade System (GTS).

### Join the Community
Don't forget to join our Discord server to connect with other players, participate in events, and share your creations. See you in the game!
author: Naotica
